avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces disopyramide plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative mood support agents

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases disopyramide levels, increasing risk of toxicity and arrhythmias
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or separate dosing by at least 2 hours

avoid_supplements.name: Licorice Root
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia risk; disopyramide itself can prolong QT interval and cause electrolyte depletion
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid; monitor potassium and magnesium levels if used

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium
caution_supplements.mechanism: High-dose supplementation may potentiate QT prolongation; disopyramide depletes magnesium
caution_supplements.action: Monitor serum levels; coordinate supplementation with healthcare provider

caution_supplements.name: Potassium
caution_supplements.mechanism: Disopyramide can cause hypokalemia; excessive supplementation may create imbalance
caution_supplements.action: Monitor electrolytes regularly; supplement only if serum levels confirm deficiency

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases disopyramide bioavailability and plasma concentrations
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate completely from diet during disopyramide therapy

caution_foods.name: High-sodium foods
caution_foods.mechanism: Sodium intake affects electrolyte balance and may influence disopyramide's antiarrhythmic effects
caution_foods.action: Maintain moderate sodium intake; monitor blood pressure and fluid balance

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may increase arrhythmia risk and counteract antiarrhythmic effects
caution_foods.action: Limit coffee, tea, chocolate, and energy drinks; monitor cardiac symptoms

monitoring_notes: Monitor ECG parameters (QT interval, PR interval) regularly and maintain serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) given disopyramide's anticholinergic effects and arrhythmogenic potential. Assess CYP3A4/2D6 inhibitor/inducer interactions closely, as disopyramide has a narrow therapeutic window.
